template_data.headline_html: Five myths I hear before anyone applies.

items.title: My company is too small
items.sub: The Schedule was built for small businesses — most applicants are under $5M in commercial revenue.

items.title: I need past performance first
items.sub: Not for the application itself. Past performance matters more once you're pursuing specific contracts.

items.title: The process costs too much
items.sub: There's no government application fee. The real cost is time — that's what done-for-you solves.

items.title: Contracts come automatically
items.sub: The Schedule is access, not a guarantee. Outreach and positioning determine whether it generates revenue.

items.title: My industry isn't a good fit
items.sub: Engineering, construction, IT, professional services — billions flow through the Schedule every quarter.
